relations.rationale: Nell finishing ahead of Ivo is independent of whether Ivo finishes ahead of Kira.
Nell ahead of Ivo directly contradicts Kira finishing ahead of Nell only if combined with other facts, but alone they concern different pairs and could both be true.
Finishing order has no bearing on relative age.
Finishing order has no bearing on height.
Finishing order has no bearing on design complexity.
Finishing order does not indicate whether designs performed equally well.
Spectators clapping as robots cleared checkpoints suggests robots completed at different times, implying some were faster.
Spectators clapping is unrelated to whether Noor specifically watched timers.
Clapping at checkpoints has no bearing on Kira's wheel adjustment after a collision.
Clapping for checkpoints is unrelated to the color of Noor's robot.
Spectator clapping has no bearing on whether Kira's and Ivo's designs performed equally well.
Spectators clapping during the event is consistent with and supports the general gathering afterward, though not a strong logical link.
Speed differences among robots have no bearing on paint color.
Watching timers closely aligns with noting each completion attentively, reinforcing the same behavior.
Noor watching timers closely has no direct bearing on the specific finishing order between Kira and Nell.
Noor's careful timing has no relation to Leo helping members solder.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira is unrelated to Kira's wheel adjustment after a collision.

If Ivo finished ahead of Kira, then Kira cannot have finished ahead of Ivo's position relative to Nell in a way that... actually these are about different people order comparisons, so no direct contradiction.
Finishing order between Ivo and Kira has no bearing on visibility of Noor's robot.
Finishing order is unrelated to the number of parts used in design.
